title: ModPackRolePlay
description: This modpack is intended for people who enjoy Minecraft roleplay on different servers.
body:
## Overview

Welcome to **FluidoComoKasuitz**! This modpack is designed to enhance the Minecraft experience with visual improvements and quality-of-life enhancements while keeping gameplay smooth and stable. It is optimized for Survival worlds and multiplayer RolePlay servers, making it perfect for long adventures with friends.

## Key Features

* **Optimized for Survival:** Built to provide a smooth and enjoyable vanilla-like Survival experience.
* **Perfect for RolePlay Servers:** Great for multiplayer communities, allowing you to enjoy immersive gameplay with friends.
* **Enhanced Visual Experience:** Improved visual effects, cleaner interface, and overall quality-of-life improvements.
* **Stable & Lightweight:** Carefully configured to maximize compatibility and performance.

## Performance & Optimization

* 🚀 **Optimized for Survival Worlds:** Designed for long Survival sessions and multiplayer gameplay.
* 🤝 **Ideal for Playing with Friends:** Perfect for private servers and RolePlay communities.
* ⚠️ **No Animation Mods Included:** This modpack does **not** include player, mob, or item animation mods to ensure maximum compatibility and avoid animation-related issues or conflicts.
* ⚡ **Performance Focused:** Optimized to maintain high FPS on most mid-range and high-end PCs.
